toolPreparation.message: Async refinement encountered during synchronous parse operation. Use .parseAsync instead.

followUps.proposal: Add cancellation-aware async preparation while retaining the synchronous API, one parse per stage, source identity, detached review input and authorization after validation. Async hooks and output review already exist.

Design an independent accepted-result channel only after specifying JSON semantics, screening, durable attribution, cancellation and replay. The selected integrity fix does not add that channel or promise Zod-inferred runtime object types.

Count invalid tool-mode output candidates and prose corrections with a dedicated checkpointed schema-retry budget. Keep reviewer rejections and cumulative call reservations separate; preserve valid paired-candidate, cancellation, compaction and resume semantics.

implementation.contract: One durable counter for missing tool-mode output and delivered unrepaired model-argument failures, once per completed response. Separate reviewer/native counters; no revalidation; verified completion metadata survives recovery.
